summary: SmartDomo multi-channel device support testing completed successfully. Fixed backend bug where get_ewelink_devices_internal() was not expanding multi-channel devices. All features working: multi-channel expansion, CH badges display, toggle ON/OFF per channel.

minor.issue: Returns 520 error when SmartThings token expired - known issue, eWeLink fallback works on devices-with-sensors

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: get_ewelink_devices_internal() was not expanding multi-channel devices. Added same expansion logic as /api/ewelink/devices endpoint
FIXED: devices-with-sensors fallback now properly includes is_channel, channel, has_channels, channel_count, and switch fields for multi-channel devices
Channel IDs use format: {parent_id}_ch{n} (e.g., 1000bab658_ch0 for Irrigazione prato CH1)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Login, SmartDomo tab, Domotica section, CH badges, toggle all working)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-channel device support fully implemented and tested. Backend now expands 4-channel SonOff/eWeLink devices (IRRIGAZIONE and SERVIZI CANCELLO) into separate virtual channels. Frontend displays CH1-CH4 badges and allows individual toggle control. SmartThings token is expired (401) but eWeLink fallback works correctly.

features_tested.multi_channel_expansion: PASS - Irrigazione prato and Serv cancello show 4 channels each
features_tested.ch_badges: PASS - CH1, CH2, CH3, CH4 badges displayed on channel cards
features_tested.toggle_channel: PASS - Toggle ON/OFF works on individual channels
features_tested.api_ewelink_devices: PASS - Returns 42 devices with expanded channels
features_tested.api_devices_with_sensors: PASS - Returns 42 devices via eWeLink fallback

bug_fixed.description: get_ewelink_devices_internal() was not expanding multi-channel devices
bug_fixed.root_cause: The internal function used by devices-with-sensors fallback was returning raw devices without the multi-channel expansion logic that exists in /api/ewelink/devices
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added multi-channel expansion logic to get_ewelink_devices_internal() and updated the fallback code to include is_channel, channel, has_channels, channel_count, and switch fields
bug_fixed.impact: Without this fix, the frontend was only showing 18-26 devices instead of 34-42 with expanded channels
